screen.reason: The paper focuses on developing a multi-stage training/fine-tuning pipeline (PG-CoT, Dynamic SFT, K-RL) for TCM prescription generation to incorporate clinical reasoning and safety contraindications, rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail on an existing system.
